standard.summary: 每 N 个优化 step 允许一次缓存释放。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Allows one cache release every N optimizer steps.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 每 N 个优化 step 允许一次缓存释放。1 最省显存；2~10 可减少同步频率，适合显存略紧但想保留速度时尝试。

advanced_en.principle: Allows one cache release every N optimizer steps. 1 saves the most VRAM; 2~10 reduces sync frequency — worth trying when VRAM is a bit tight but you want to keep speed.
